name: Shri Nitin Jairam Gadkari
education:
B.Com., LL.B.
 G.S. Commerce College, Nagpur University and University College of Law, Main Branch, Nagpur
social_activities: Organised `Khasdar Sounkrutik Mahostava` in the last three years; Has been working on the socio-economic front and taking various initiatives to empower the downtrodden people from the tribal, remote and drought prone Vidarbha region; Visionary ideas are helping in water conservation and in the conversion of agricultural waste into clean and efficient fuel; Started working in the field of renewable energy and patronized several innovative projects; Introduced the concept of converting agricultural waste into a cost effective and efficient fuel whereby the biomass is converted into small pellets which can be burnt in a specially designed stove and can be used as a clean and efficient fuel; Realizing that the perennial availability of the water can change the future of the farmers, Actively started mentoring various projects in water conservation to improve the livelihood of farmers in the water starved Vidarbha region; Taking inspiration from the saying ‘education can bring sea change in the life of one and also change the fate of the nation’ played a leading role in the formation of the Late Laxmanrao Mankad Memorial Trust and took the work of starting of Ekal Vidyalayas in the different parts of Vidarbha, mostly in the tribal areas of Gadchiroli and Melghat in Amravati District which inter alia suffer from malnutrition; Was also instrumental in the formation of the Institute of Village Enterprise Development of Handicraft Artists (VEDHA India) which is working with the bamboo workers from the bamboo producing areas thereby helping generate employment for them and add to their income.
interests: Agriculture and Renewable Energy; Organizing health check up Camps through NGOs for the last ten years for needy poor families
hobbies: Classical music concerts organised round the year
sports: `Khasdar Krida Mahostava`organised for last two years. The events were participated by over 10000 sport persons.
books: (i) India Aspires (English); (ii) Bhavishya Ka Bharat (Hindi); (iii) The Path of Progress (English); (iv) Vikas Ke Path (Hindi); (v) The Politics of Development (English); (vi) Vikas Ki Rajneeti (Hindi); (vii) Sabhapati Mahodaya; (viii) Pahla Kadam

other_information: "Agro Vision" - the biggest exhibition for farmers of Vidarbha region organised every year in Nagpur for last ten years. More than five lac farmers visited the exhibition; 734 Adivasi Ekal Schools are run by NGOs in Tribal belt for last ten years.
